spells/power-word-maladroit-3088.name: Power Word Maladroit
spells/power-word-maladroit-3088.effectSummary: Instantly deals 2 points of Dexterity damage to one living creature with 75 hit points or fewer, whether or not it can hear the word. The target's current hit points determine the result: 25 or fewer converts the 2 Dexterity damage to 2 points of Dexterity drain instead; 26–50 makes the Dexterity damage last 1d4+1 minutes; 51–75 makes it last 1d4+1 rounds. A creature with 76 or more current hit points is unaffected.
tables: The Dexterity damage is ability drain instead
spells/power-word-maladroit-3088.notes: Races of the Dragon contains an internal boundary contradiction: the target line says '75 HP or less' and the table includes 51–75, while the final prose sentence says '75 or more' is unaffected. No official erratum resolving this sentence was identified. This review uses the internally consistent target+table reading that 75 HP is affected and immunity begins at 76 HP, while preserving the contradiction here rather than silently hiding it.

spells/summon-living-dragonmark-4919.name: Summon Living Dragonmark
spells/summon-living-dragonmark-4919.effectSummary: Summons one neutral Medium ooze-shaped living dragonmark at a point within range for 1 round per level; it acts immediately on your turn, attacks opponents to the best of its ability, can be directed to particular enemies, and cannot perform other actions. You can have only one living dragonmark summoned at a time, and the spell requires a lesser, greater, or Siberys true dragonmark. The creature has initiative +4; blindsight 60 feet; Listen +0 and Spot +0; fly speed 60 feet (perfect); 6 HD; base attack +4; grapple +8; Strength 18, Dexterity 18, Constitution —, Intelligence —, Wisdom 11, Charisma 10; Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +2; damage reduction 10/magic; immunity to acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, positive energy, negative energy, and the normal ooze immunities. Its AC includes its +4 Dexterity bonus plus a deflection bonus equal to the summoner's Charisma modifier. A mark summoned by a caster with a lesser dragonmark has 33 hit points; one summoned by a greater or Siberys mark has 48 hit points. Its force slam attack is +8 and deals damage by mark strength: Lesser 1d6+6, Greater 1d8+6, Siberys 2d6+6. On a successful slam it can use improved grab to begin a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity; after establishing a hold it can constrict for normal force-slam damage on a successful grapple check, but cannot constrict a creature larger than itself.
spells/summon-living-dragonmark-4919.notes: Dragonmarked stat block and damage table are fully captured and table-digest locked. The summary preserves the summoned creature's complete operational statistics instead of reducing the review to its force-slam table.
